title: Registered Nurse (RN) ICU
description:

Job Details at a Glance

Job Title: Registered Nurse (RN) ICU | Location: Panama City, FL | Schedule: Full-Time, Variable Shifts | Hiring Incentive: Competitive compensation and a robust benefits package

Registered Nurse (RN) ICU

Virtus Healthcare Staffing is searching for a dynamic and compassionate ICU Registered Nurse to join our partner, a leading medical center in Panama City, FL. We are seeking a reliable professional who is ready to provide high-focus, high-acuity care with the autonomy to make clinical assessments and manage treatment. Join a phenomenal team that works hard to support each other while providing excellent, collaborative care to patients.

Position Overview

As an ICU RN, you will be a vital member of the patient care team, responsible for the close monitoring and frequent assessments of critically ill patients. You will serve as a dedicated patient and family advocate, protecting their privacy and confidentiality. In this role, you will apply your expertise and judgment to make autonomous clinical decisions, ensuring the highest quality of care and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide direct, specialized nursing care to critically ill patients who require close monitoring and frequent assessments.

  • Make clinical assessments and autonomously manage treatment as required.

  • Serve as the patient and family advocate, ensuring privacy and confidentiality are protected.

  • Instruct patients and families regarding medications and treatment instructions.

  • Collaborate with physicians and other members of the healthcare team to ensure a comprehensive approach to patient care.

Qualifications

  • Required Qualifications:

    • A Florida RN license and/or approved multistate RN license is required. Compact license holders have 60 days to obtain the Florida license after relocation.

    • A BLS-AHA Provider issued card is required within 30 days of your start date.

    • ACLS is required within 6 months of hire.

  • Preferred Qualifications:

    • A Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) is preferred.

    • A CCRN (Certification for Adult, Pediatric and Neonatal Critical Care Nurses) certification is preferred.

Benefits

Our partner offers an exceptionally comprehensive benefits and compensation package that begins on your first day of employment, including:

  • Medical & Wellness: Comprehensive medical coverage that covers many common services at no cost or for a low copay. Options for dental and vision benefits, free telemedicine services, free medical transportation, and free counseling services for emotional, physical, and financial well-being.

  • Financial & Retirement: A 401(k) Plan with a 100% match on 3% to 9% of pay (based on years of service), an employee stock purchase plan, retirement readiness services, and education assistance (tuition, student loan, certification support).

  • Work-Life Balance: A Time Away From Work Program (paid time off, paid family leave, and long- and short-term disability coverage). Referral services for child, elder, and pet care, as well as moving assistance and discount programs.

  • Professional Development: A colleague recognition program and opportunities for ongoing learning and professional growth.

If you are a qualified and compassionate ICU Nurse ready for a rewarding career move, apply today through Virtus Healthcare Staffing.

Manager of Med/Surg/Telemetry

Virtus Healthcare Staffing is searching for a dynamic and experienced Manager of Med/Surg/Telemetry to join our partner, a leading medical center in Wildomar, CA. As the Manager of Med/Surg/Telemetry, you will be accountable for the overall management and leadership of your units on a day-to-day basis. This includes ensuring efficient resource utilization, effective staff management, and achieving key quality outcomes. You will maintain a high level of accuracy in all departmental functions and will be instrumental in fostering a positive work environment where communication and collaboration are paramount. Your role is central to defining problems, collecting data, and drawing valid conclusions to continuously improve patient care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide direct supervision, guidance, and mentorship to all nursing staff within the Med/Surg and Telemetry units.

  • Manage daily operational activities, including scheduling, resource allocation, and maintaining departmental budgets.

  • Ensure a strong understanding of and compliance with all quality and safety mandates from regulatory agencies, including the Joint Commission.

  • Collaborate with physicians, other departments, and hospital leadership to define and achieve strategic goals for the units.

  • Develop and implement policies and procedures that support excellence in patient care.

  • Participate in staff recruitment, training, and performance evaluations.

Qualifications

    • A Master's degree from an accredited college or university is preferred.

  • Experience:

    • A minimum of two years of recent, department-specific experience is required.

    • Charge nurse or other supervisory experience is preferred.

  • Licenses/Certifications:

    • A current California Registered Nurse (RN) license is required.

    • A current BLS certification is required.

    • ACLS certification is required.

    • Basic EKG/tele interpretation experience is required, or completion of a Basic EKG class within six months of employment.

The successful candidate will receive a competitive compensation package and access to comprehensive benefits, including:

  • Opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

Med Surg Nurse - TN Visa

Virtus Healthcare Staffing is searching for a dedicated and compassionate Med Surg Nurse to join our partner, a leading medical center in Tuscaloosa, AL. This is a unique and rewarding opportunity for qualified international candidates, as we provide comprehensive support for the TN Visa and immigration process. We are offering a $12,000 sign-on bonus , up to $4,000 in relocation assistance , and 60 days of free housing to welcome the right candidate to our team.

Position Overview

As a Med Surg Nurse, you will be a vital member of the patient care team, responsible for planning, coordinating, and directing high-quality, compassionate care. You will work to build positive therapeutic relationships with patients and their families while ensuring the highest standards of professional nursing practice are maintained. This position also includes supervisory responsibilities, overseeing LPNs, PCAs, and other non-licensed staff.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and coordinate patient care by maintaining standards of professional nursing practice.

  • Assess the condition of each assigned patient on admission and on an ongoing basis.

  • Evaluate and regularly re-evaluate patient care, coordinating care plans with patients, families, providers, and other disciplines.

  • Assign and delegate nursing care to team members in accordance with the patient's needs and the capabilities of the team.

  • Apply safety principles when performing care and provide accurate handoff reports.

  • Accurately document observations, care provided, and changes in the care plan.

  • Assist in performance improvement (PI) activities to ensure a culture of continuous improvement.

What You Bring

  • Required Qualifications:

    • A current approved Alabama Board of Nursing RN license or multi-state license is required, or the ability to obtain prior to your start date.

    • A current American Heart Association (AHA) or client Basic Life Support (BLS) Provider training is required.

    • At least two years of recent experience in acute care, with experience in admissions, discharges, and patient monitoring.

  • Education and Skills:

    • An Associate's degree in Nursing is required; a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) is preferred.

    • Proficiency with Electronic Medical Records (EMR).

    • Ability to work all shifts as needed.

  • For TN Visa Candidates:

    • The NCLEX and English exam (TOEFL, IELTS, or PTE if not a native English speaker) and Visa screen fees are reimbursed for candidates currently outside the USA.

    • You will be supported in the Green card process after six months of completing your probationary period.

Why Join Our Team?

We believe that providing great care starts with supporting and rewarding our team. In addition to base salary and shift differentials, this position offers:

  • Comprehensive benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance.

  • A 401k retirement plan.

  • Tuition assistance and many more opportunities for professional growth.

Join us and be part of a team that leads with heart, cultivates trust, and always goes beyond. Apply today and start your journey towards making a meaningful impact!
